title: Damped oscillator dashboard
description: lmnum integrates a damped second-order oscillator with CVODE and checks the endpoint against the closed form; lmplot builds a three-panel dashboard from the saved solution: time series against the analytic response, phase portrait, and energy decaying inside its exp(-2 zeta omega t) envelope.

title: Discounted project cashflows
description: lmfinance discounts project cashflows continuously at 8%; lmnum reads those computed values and lmdraw draws their amounts, present values and net present value.

title: Shallow-water gravity pulse
description: lmweather evolves a Gaussian shallow-water pulse; lmplot overlays four snapshots and labels the gravity-wave speed.

title: Hohmann transfer: equal-time markers
description: lmspace propagates a Hohmann transfer from a 7000 km orbit to geostationary radius; lmcad renders the sampled trajectory as a tube between the departure and arrival rings, with markers at equal time intervals that bunch up near apogee where the spacecraft is slowest.

title: Cargo-ramp force balance
description: lmphysics measures acceleration of a six-kilogram cargo block on a 24-degree ramp; lmdraw draws the force balance with correctly oriented, consistently scaled vectors.

title: Finite-element Poisson field
description: lmfluid solves a manufactured Poisson problem and lmplot renders the sampled field with a color ramp.

title: Michaelis-Menten from mechanism
description: lmbio integrates the elementary reactions E + S <-> ES -> E + P at ten substrate levels and measures the quasi-steady rate of each run; lmplot shows those rates falling on the hyperbola Vmax S / (Km + S) with Km = (koff + kcat) / kon and Vmax = kcat E0, constants the mechanism never states.

title: Cell growth and motility
description: lmcell evolves two motile populations with different cycle and death rates; lmplot compares their computed final positions and total living-cell count over time.

title: Photon attenuation and build-up in water
description: lmparticle runs seeded Monte Carlo histories of 662 keV photons through six water slabs and counts uncollided photons and all forward crossings; lmplot compares the uncollided fraction with exp(-mu x) on a log axis and shows the scattered build-up above it.

title: Water dimer: hydrogen bond in 3D
description: lmmolecule minimizes two flexible TIP3P molecules into the hydrogen-bonded dimer (about -6.5 kcal/mol at R(O-O) = 2.74 A) and scans the acceptor along the O-O axis; lmcad renders the minimized coordinates as ball-and-stick with the hydrogen bond as a cyan rod; lmplot places that render beside the energy curve.

title: Shielding by mass: lead, aluminum, water
description: lmparticle transports 662 keV photons through lead, aluminum and water slabs of equal mass per area; lmdraw draws the three layouts to scale; lmplot combines that layout with the measured transmission curves, showing that per gram lead is only modestly better where Compton scattering dominates.

title: Geostrophic adjustment, animated
description: lmweather releases a 600 km Gaussian height bump at rest on an f-plane: inertia-gravity waves radiate at sqrt(gH) while a weaker balanced bump set by the Rossby radius stays behind, with potential vorticity conserved; lmplot renders a frame every 30 minutes and ffmpeg assembles the 14-hour animation.

title: Dosing regimen inside a therapeutic window
description: lmbio integrates a one-compartment oral model for 800 mg a day given as 400 mg every 12 h or 800 mg daily, restarting at each dose; both share the asserted average level 7.2 mg/L but only the twice-daily regimen stays inside 3-12 mg/L. lmdraw draws the compartment model; lmplot overlays window, average and both profiles.

title: Damping-ratio sweep as a contact sheet
description: lmnum integrates the unit-step response of a second-order system for six damping ratios and checks each overshoot against exp(-pi zeta / sqrt(1 - zeta^2)); lmplot draws one panel per case; lmimg assembles the panels into a labelled report sheet with a header band.

title: Equalizer: designed versus measured
description: lmaudio designs a three-band equalizer as biquads (low shelf, presence peak, high shelf), measures the whole chain by passing a unit impulse through it, and sends a plucked string through the same chain; lmplot overlays the designed band responses with the measured chain and the dry and equalized string spectra.

title: Kepler orbit energy check
description: lmspace propagates an eccentric orbit (perigee 7000 km, apogee 15000 km) for two periods with RK45 at 1e-12 tolerance; lmplot draws the path, the radius against time and the relative energy error, whose largest excursion is about 2e-12, a measured integrator noise floor.

title: Driven oscillator: transient to steady state
description: lmnum integrates a damped oscillator driven near resonance from rest, with the forcing carried as a third ODE state, and checks the late-time amplitude against the closed form; lmplot draws the beating transient settling onto the steady amplitude and the (x, v) phase portrait.

title: Intermediate-axis tumble of a free plate
description: lmphysics spins a free plate at 10 rad/s about its intermediate principal axis, nudged by 0.01 rad/s; the recorded body angular velocity shows the tennis-racket instability growing into tumbles every 3 s, while kinetic energy and angular momentum drift below 1e-5. The composition is drawn in lmplot, and the same flip appears in the lmphysics tennis_racket example.

title: Finite-element error against a known answer
description: lmfluid solves a Poisson problem on an 8 x 8 mesh with linear and quadratic elements for a quadratic exact solution; the quadratic elements reproduce it to solver tolerance while the linear error map shows the element pattern. lmplot draws both |error| maps on one colour scale.

title: Heat conduction in x and t
description: lmnum integrates one-dimensional heat conduction by the method of lines with its stiff solver and checks the result against the exact exponential decay; lmplot draws the x-t spacetime heat map and the profiles at three times against the exact curves.

title: Forecast with a 95 % prediction band
description: lmnum fits a trend with annual harmonics to 60 months of demand by least squares, computes the residual deviation and the 95 % prediction interval of each of 12 future months from the design matrix, and checks that the true future values fall inside the band; lmplot draws the history, the fit, the forecast and its widening band.

title: Seasonal decomposition by least squares
description: lmnum fits a quadratic trend with annual and semi-annual harmonics to eight years of monthly data in one least-squares solve, and recovers the 10-unit annual amplitude and the 2.5 residual deviation within stated tolerances; lmplot draws observed, trend, seasonal and residual panels on a shared time axis.

title: Regression diagnostics: predicted, actual and residuals
description: lmnum fits a linear model to 120 observations that contain a quadratic term it does not include, with R^2 and RMSE from the least-squares solve; the predicted-against-actual and residuals-against-predicted panels show the misfit as a curve in the residuals.

title: Daily sign-ups on a date axis
description: lmnum generates a seeded year of daily sign-ups with a trend and a weekend effect, builds the trailing 7-day mean and checks that weekends fall about 12 below weekdays; lmplot draws the daily counts and the mean on a real date axis, with the start date converted by gnuplot strptime.

title: Call-centre queue over one day
description: lmnum evaluates the M/M/c Erlang-C formula for eight agents at each hour of a day with a peak arrival rate of 70 calls per hour, after checking the textbook value C(2, 1) = 1/3; lmplot draws the busy agents on the right axis and the mean queue length on the left.

title: Quarterly business review deck with lmvideo charts
description: lmvideo draws three Skia charts (quarterly revenue, operating margin, regional mix) from one set of figures; lmoffice places them on the slides of a six-slide Open XML deck with highlights, bullets and notes. The picture is a LibreOffice render of the finished deck.

title: Sales report with a chart per section
description: lmvideo draws three Skia charts (revenue by region, by product line, and the monthly trend); lmoffice builds a Word report with a heading, text, chart and figure table for each section. The script checks that regions and products each add up to the Q3 total. The picture is a LibreOffice render of the document.

title: Forecast workbook with a native chart
description: lmnum fits a linear trend to 24 months of sales by least squares and checks the slope and residual deviation; lmvideo draws the forecast with its 95 % band as a PNG; lmoffice writes an Excel workbook with the forecast table, variance formulas and a native bar chart beside it. The picture is a LibreOffice render of the workbook.

title: Invoice with a generated logo and payment glyph
description: lmvideo draws a logo and a deterministic 21 x 21 QR-like glyph as PNG images; lmoffice places them in a Word invoice with a line-item table, tax and totals. The glyph is decorative and not a scannable code. The script checks the subtotal, tax and total. The picture is a LibreOffice render of the invoice.

title: Resume with a skills bar chart
description: lmvideo draws six horizontal skill bars with their levels on a Skia canvas as a PNG; lmoffice places the chart in a Word resume with a summary, experience and education. The picture is a LibreOffice render of the resume.

title: Science report: damping recovered from simulated peaks
description: lmnum integrates a damped oscillator at three damping ratios with CVODE, refines the peaks, and estimates each damping ratio from the logarithmic decrement, asserting 1 % agreement; lmvideo plots measured against set damping with the identity line; lmoffice writes the report with a method section, a results table, the figure and a conclusion. The picture is a LibreOffice render of the report.

title: Annual revenue bars with currency ticks
description: lmnum builds 11 years of revenue from a seeded 17 % compound growth model with 2 % noise and recovers the growth rate by a least-squares fit of the logarithm, asserting it within 0.01; lmplot draws the bars with native $0B to $300B axis ticks and a value label on each bar.

title: Standing waves on a membrane, animated
description: lmnum discretizes the Laplacian of a square membrane, takes its eigenvalues and checks the lowest and the twice-degenerate second against the closed form; the mode frequencies drive an lmvideo animation of two superposed standing-wave modes over one period, encoded to MP4 with ffmpeg. The picture is the in-phase first frame.

title: Image pipeline with a before/after contact sheet
description: lmimg builds a procedural landscape, runs levels, unsharp and colour-curve steps, measures SSIM and PSNR against the original, and writes a three-panel contact sheet; lmoffice places the sheet on an Open XML slide with the measured values as bullets. The picture is a LibreOffice render of the slide.

title: Rates and options desk pack: curve, option table and memo
description: lmfinance bootstraps a six-pillar zero-rate curve and prices a one-year at-the-money call at five spot levels, checking the textbook value 10.4506; lmvideo draws the curve as a PNG; lmoffice writes an Excel workbook with stored discount-factor and payoff formulas and native line and bar charts, and a Word memo that quotes the same numbers. The picture is a LibreOffice render of the workbook.
